headline: Approved Nan McKay contract piggyback for Mexico, Missouri, trash bag price increase to $73.16 per case, and $6,131.82 in tenant balance write-offs.
summary: The board approved letting the Housing Authority of the City of Mexico, Missouri use MHA's Nan McKay task order contract. It also approved an amended contract amount, a trash bag price increase from WASTEZERO, and two additional tenant balance write-offs totaling $6,131.82.
decisions: Approved permitting the Housing Authority of the City of Mexico, Missouri to piggyback MHA's Nan McKay task order contract.
Approved amending the August 11, 2026 vote on the Contract for Financial Assistance Work Plan #5001, increasing it by $275,140.67 for a revised total of $22,574,509.05.
Approved a 7.2% price increase from WASTEZERO, raising MHA black trash bags from $68.25 to $73.16 per case.
Approved two additional tenant balance write-offs totaling $6,131.82, with Attorney Danielle Walsh able to pursue collection at her discretion.

decision_evidence.quote: To approve to permit the Housing Authority of the City of Mexico, Missouri to piggyback MHA's Nan McKay task order contract and authorize the Executive Director to sign any necessary documents.
To approve the amendment of the vote taken on 8/11/26 (see meeting minutes, item 3R) "Contract for Financial Assistance Work Plan #5001" as stated above.
To approve price increase from WASTEZERO for MHA trash bags as detailed above.
To approve two (2) additional tenant balance write offs as detailed above with Attorney Danielle Walsh having the ability to pursue collection if recovery is possible at her discretion.
